description: MyCiTi IRT bus routes and stops, Cape Town, South Africa, 2026 is a data set listed in Transport Data Commons (Transport Data Catalogue), a transport data catalogue, published or maintained by Transformative Urban Mobility Initiative (TUMI). Bus routes and stops of the MyCiTi integrated rapid transit (IRT) system in Cape Town and its suburbs. Coverage: South Africa. The portal files it under the publisher Transformative Urban Mobility Initiative (TUMI). Its tags are brt, irt, public transport. It offers 6 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-08-20 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (data set page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-tdc-portal.
